### What was built

**`import FILE --format csv|json`** (`src/bookmarks/cli.py`, `storage.py`) — a strict read → parse → validate → insert pipeline. `read_import_text` catches `OSError`/`UnicodeDecodeError` at the read site so a file error exits 2 while an unusable store still exits 1; `parse_csv_import` enforces the exact `id,url,title,tags` header and exactly four fields per row (no `DictReader`, no padding); `parse_json_import` requires an array of objects with `url`/`title`/`tags` and ignores `id` and unknown keys; `ImportRejected` (the one new class, deliberately not a `ValueError`) carries each diagnostic to the single catch point in `_import`; `storage.add_bookmarks` does one `executemany` + one `commit`.

**`export --format html`** — `escape_html` (exactly `&`, `<`, `>`, `"`; the apostrophe stays verbatim) and `render_html` (a fixed line list, so the empty store needs no branch), plus the `_export` branch and `html` in `--format`'s `choices`.
